fields.description: Roles allowed to submit bug reports. If empty, defaults to 'Bug Reporter Tester', 'Bug Reporter Manager', and 'System Manager'.
fields.label: Allowed Roles

fields.description: Options mirror Bug Report's own Severity field - kept in sync automatically (bug_reporter_settings.js), not duplicated here.
fields.label: Default Severity

fields.description: Options mirror Bug Report's own Priority field - kept in sync automatically (bug_reporter_settings.js), not duplicated here.
fields.label: Default Priority

fields.description: Whenever a request crashes with an unhandled server exception (HTTP 500), automatically create a Bug Report and notify the recipients below - independent of anyone clicking "Report Bug". Does not fire for routine validation/permission errors, since those never reach Frappe's own Error Log.
fields.label: Auto-capture Unhandled Server Errors

fields.description: Automatically create a Bug Report whenever a logged-in user's browser hits an uncaught JS error or unhandled promise rejection, without them clicking "Report Bug".
fields.label: Auto-capture Browser Console Errors

fields.description: If the same error recurs within this many minutes, it is not reported again as a new Bug Report / email - prevents a repeating error from flooding the developer's inbox.
fields.label: Duplicate Suppression Window (minutes)

fields.description: Delete Screenshot/attachment files from closed or rejected Bug Reports after this many days. 0 = keep forever.
fields.label: Evidence Retention (days, 0 = keep forever)

fields.description: Users notified whenever a new Bug Report is submitted, in addition to the assignee.
fields.label: Notification Recipients

fields.description: Every new Bug Report (manual or automatic) also creates a matching Redmine issue, assigned to the Redmine user whose email matches the Bug Report's Assigned To. Never blocks Bug Report creation itself if Redmine is unreachable or misconfigured.
fields.label: Sync Bug Reports to Redmine

fields.description: Base URL of your Redmine instance, e.g. https://redmine.example.com (no trailing slash).
fields.label: Redmine URL

fields.description: The short slug from the project's URL (Project Settings → Identifier), not its display name.
fields.label: Redmine Project Identifier

fields.description: Redmine → My Account → API access key. Must belong to a member of the target project - assignee-by-email matching looks up the project's own member list, so no admin-level key is required.
fields.label: Redmine API Key

fields.description: Numeric tracker ID to file issues under - check Redmine → Administration → Trackers for the exact ID on your instance (a stock install usually has 1 = Bug).
fields.label: Redmine Tracker ID

fields.description: Used when the Bug Report's Assigned To user's email doesn't match any Redmine user, or when Assigned To is blank. Leave at 0 to create the issue unassigned in that case.
fields.label: Fallback Redmine Assignee (User ID)

fields.description: Only needed if your Redmine project has a REQUIRED custom field on issues (distinct from Redmine's native, per-project Issue Category feature - check by opening Redmine's New Issue form for this project: if a required field appears that isn't in Administration → Trackers/Fields as a built-in, it's a custom field). Find its numeric ID by opening any existing issue in that project via the API, e.g. {Redmine URL}/issues/<id>.json, and reading the "id" under custom_fields for the field with the matching name. Leave at 0 if the project has no such required field.
fields.label: Required Custom Field ID

fields.description: The exact value to send for that custom field on every synced issue (must match one of its allowed options exactly, e.g. "Non Billable - Bug Fixes").
fields.label: Required Custom Field Value

fields.description: Checked periodically (see scheduler). When a synced issue's Redmine status exactly matches this name, its linked Bug Report here is automatically moved to Resolved - only applies to reports currently Pending or Reopened, and only moves them forward to Resolved (never touches Rejected reports, never moves anything backward). Must match a real status name in Redmine exactly, e.g. "Deployed to UAT".
fields.label: Redmine Status That Marks Resolved
